summary.text: On Jamuraa, the peacemaker Mangara brings the rival nations together with peace agreements, but Kaervek resents the peace, persuades the reclusive Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, and with her seals him in an Amber Prison.
With Mangara gone the peace unravels into the Mirage War, as Kaervek demands the nations' surrender and they defy him, Jolrael realizes the truth and attacks him at sea, and Teferi sinks his fleet.
Mangara is freed, defeats Kaervek and locks him in the same prison, while in the north the tyrant Johan fights the city-states led by Hazezon Tamar until a sand wurm devours him.
